result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales-rep list uses.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10021). I replaced the `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` clause with the `CASE t.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 0 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.opened_date, t.id` ordering from the sales-rep query, and updated the Javadoc to match. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

`RegionManagerTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` pass offline. I did not add a test for the new ordering. Nothing is committed.
